Deactivates when no damage is dealt or received in the last ${3+#d} seconds. //add #e once known

enhanced (
var d = 0 //placeholder
#e Time until the perk deactivates is extended.

After being in Combat for 6 seconds:
Grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness and 35% Flinch Resistance for 5 seconds.

Can activate while stowed. Dealing and receiving damage refreshes the buff duration.

For Pefect Float, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last #e${3+#d} seconds.

enhanced (
var d = 0.5 //placeholder
#e Allowed time between damage exchanges is extended by 0.5 seconds.
)

For Pefect Float, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 3 seconds.

#e Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.
